title: Move with joystick
description: Walk around with the on-screen joystick (or WASD / arrow keys).

title: Jump on button
description: Press the "jump" button to jump. Needs a RigidBody + Collider.

title: Tap to move
description: Tap the ground and walk there, around walls.

title: Spin
description: Rotate constantly around the up axis.

title: Follow the player
description: Chase the entity named "Player" and stop when close.

title: Patrol between two points
description: Walk back and forth between two objects you pick in the Inspector (each enemy its own).

title: Spawn every second
description: Create a "Coin" (prefab or object name) near this entity every second.

title: Collect coin on collision
description: Put on the Player: touching a Coin destroys it and adds 1 to Score.

title: Change color on tap
description: Tap the object to cycle through colors.

title: Restart when falling
description: Restart the scene if this entity falls below the world.

title: Show score (global)
description: Global script: keeps a Text entity named "ScoreText" updated.

title: Swipe lanes (runner)
description: Swipe left/right to switch between 3 lanes, swipe up to jump.

title: Get in and out of a vehicle
description: Put on the Player. Press the "use" button next to a boat or car (tag #vehicle) to get in or out. Seating and the camera are automatic; steering is yours.

title: Drive a car or walk with the joystick
description: Put on a Car, Boat or Platformer object. The behavior never reads the joystick: you pass it in.
